news.title: Trump administration uses rare authority to claw back nearly $1B in spending approved by Congress
news.summary: President Trump is canceling nearly $1 billion in spending approved by Congress, and most of the cuts are focused on HHS programs that serve refugees and unaccompanied minors.

news.title: STAT+: Licensing deals on generic versions of Roche flu drug aimed at preparing for pandemic
news.summary: With an eye toward pandemic preparedness, a U.N.-backed agency has signed sub-licensing deals related to generic versions of a Roche influenza treatment.

news.title: STAT+: Lilly wins approval for once-weekly insulin shot
news.summary: The FDA approved Eli Lilly’s Onswik, a once-weekly basal insulin for adults with type 2 diabetes, offering patients an alternative to daily long-acting insulin injections.

news.title: Opinion: FDA commissioner nominee Heidi Overton is ignoring the science on abortion drug
news.summary: “With this latest appointment, mifepristone has a new boss but an old problem,” writes Julie F. Kay, founder and CEO of Reproductive Futures.

news.title: STAT+: Up and down the ladder: The latest comings and goings
news.summary: From new hires to departures, promotions and transfers, here are the latest comings and goings in the pharmaceutical industry.

news.title: STAT+: Pharmalittle: We’re reading about a reticent FDA commish nominee, a Novo deal, and more
news.summary: President Trump’s nominee to lead the FDA was grilled by senators on hot button topics like China, vaccines, and abortion access

news.title: Federal judge rolls back landmark disability protections
news.summary: The Justice Department said in June that it would no longer enforce laws that prioritized people with disabilities living and receiving services in their communities, rather than in nursing homes…

news.title: How Big Tobacco flooded the FDA with public comments to kill a menthol cigarette ban
news.summary: Virtually all of the 175,000 public comments on a 2022 FDA proposal to ban menthol cigarettes were form letters, most echoing tobacco industry talking points.

news.title: At least five candidates vie to become the next WHO leader, as questions over U.S. role loom
news.summary: At least five candidates are in the running to become the next director-general of the WHO, a job that will come with extraordinary challenges.

news.title: STAT+: The head of Kennedy’s new autism project has roots in Iraq War, Sesame Street
news.summary: Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health is planning a total-lifespan research project on autism: A Q&A with its leader, Russell Shilling.

news.title: Opinion: RFK Jr.’s use of the National Center for Health Statistics will add confusion to measles deaths count
news.summary: “A discrepancy between how federal and state public health officials determine measles deaths will only increase public confusion,” write Denys T. Lau and Jennifer D. Schoendorf.

news.title: Opinion: The ‘died with’ vs. ‘died of’ measles discussion misses something very important
news.summary: “Arguing over whether someone died ‘with’ or ‘of’ a disease gets us stuck on the last thing that happened.” write two Unbiased Science scientists.

news.title: STAT+: FDA commissioner nominee Heidi Overton keeps opinions to herself in Senate hearing
news.summary: Senators focused on asking Overton about vaccines, abortion, and vapes.

news.title: The FDA’s Overton era, and dispatches from Shanghai
news.summary: The Readout LOUD is going international this week with a dispatch from Shanghai, along with notes on the FDA's Overton era.

news.title: Senate finance committee backs Chris Klomp, advancing him to full Senate vote
news.summary: Klomp, a behind-the-scenes HHS power player, is likely to be confirmed as second-in-command to RFK Jr.

news.title: 37 states partner with CMS on initiative to rethink Medicaid quality measures
news.summary: The Trump administration announced Friday that it is launching a new partnership with 37 states that aims to rethink how quality is measured in Medicaid and CHIP.

news.title: Brigham and Women's nurses authorize open-ended strike
news.summary: With contract talks stalled since August, unionized Mass General Brigham employees voted 93% in favor of a 4,000-nurse demonstration that could be the largest in Massachusetts history.

news.title: Weekly Rundown: Abridge poised for broader VA expansion; Hims & Hers builds out AI-native care
news.summary: The latest news from Hims & Hers, Abridge, Penn State Health, epocrates and more.

news.title: New employer, clinician alliance to advocate for direct contracting
news.summary: A new coalition is bringing together employers, clinicians and other stakeholders to push for the expansion of direct contracting.

news.title: Industry Voices—How can the telehealth sector shape the future of healthcare while securing its own?
news.summary: Partnerships and integration, not isolation, are the key to long-term success and value for all, write experts from the Center for Digital Health and Artificial Intelligence at Johns Hopkins Carey Business School.

news.title: Adventist Health strikes $18.5M settlement resolving sexual abuse lawsuit
news.summary: The settlement translates to more than $2.6 million per plaintiff, “representing one of the nation’s largest per-plaintiff recoveries in a sexual abuse case involving a medical provider,” the law firm Lewis & Llewellyn said.

news.title: Cigna Group, OpenAI team up to support patients with complex conditions
news.summary: Cigna is teaming up with OpenAI to build out more personalized supports for individuals with complex conditions, starting with a focus on cancer patients.

news.title: Maine governor urges Prime Healthcare hospital to reinstate fired nurses amid heated unionization vote
news.summary: Accusations of retaliatory firings and suspensions have been met with denouncement of an "increasingly aggressive" national smear campaign at Central Maine Medical Center, which was acquired by Prime Healthcare's nonprofit wing earlier this year.

news.title: Trump's FDA pick Heidi Overton calls vaccines, mifepristone safe and effective in confirmation hearing
news.summary: The Senate Committee on Health, Education, Labor and Pensions (HELP) today questioned Heidi Overton, M.D., Ph.D., Trump’s pick for FDA commissioner, in a hearing marked by tightrope-walking on issues like vaccines, abortions, flavored vapes and whether or not President Donald Trump is capable of being wrong.

news.title: UnitedHealth Group creates new chief administrative officer position
news.summary: UnitedHealth Group has named Jodee Kozlak to the newly-created role of chief administrative officer, the healthcare giant announced Thursday morning.

news.title: Senate Finance Committee advances Klomp's nomination as HHS Deputy Secretary
news.summary: The Senate Finance Committee has advanced the nominees for two key Department of Health and Human Services posts.

news.title: Berry Street, Abbott partner to link Lingo CGM with nutrition coaching
news.summary: Through the partnership, Abbott’s Lingo, an over-the-counter continuous glucose monitor, will now feature live nutrition coaching from Berry Street.

news.title: Lundbeck to move US digs to Boston as it eyes bigger innovation frontiers
news.summary: With Lundbeck steering its R&D engine toward increasingly specialized neuroscience targets, the Danish drugmaker is plotting a U.S. HQ move to one of the country’s preeminent biopharma hotspots.

news.title: Pioneer of China NewCo model sued in US over trade secret misuse, double-dealing
news.summary: A legal feud unfolding in New York is putting a spotlight on the work of a business development veteran who is credited for pioneering one of biopharma’s hottest dealmaking mechanism: the China “NewCo” model.

news.title: Chutes & Ladders—Travere chief makes way for former Amicus CEO
news.summary: Travere Therapeutics CEO Eric Dube, Ph.D., is stepping down after overseeing the launch of the rare kidney disease drug Filspari.

news.title: Indivior ends PAM drug collab with Addex ahead of Supernus merger
news.summary: Ahead of its upcoming merger with Supernus, Indivior Pharmaceuticals has ended its long-running collaboration with Addex Therapeutics to develop positive allosteric modulators (PAMs).

news.title: Novo inks $1.3B Nanexa deal to unlock long-acting obesity injectables
news.summary: Novo has struck a 1.17 billion euro ($1.3 billion) deal to combine Nanexa’s long-acting injectable drug delivery platform with its obesity and Type 2 diabetes drugs.

news.title: Roche's Genentech inks $1.5B bispecific pact with fast-rising Earendil
news.summary: Roche’s Genentech is paying Earendil Labs $55 million upfront to discover and develop multiple bispecific antibodies. The deal, which focuses on oncology, includes milestones that could take the deal's value above $1.5 billion.

news.title: ADARx scores upsized $446M IPO, while fellow RNA biotech City maps out Nasdaq plans
news.summary: ADARx Pharmaceuticals has overshot its own IPO ambitions, as fellow RNA-focused biotech City Therapeutics also plans a public listing.

news.title: Trump's FDA pick Heidi Overton calls vaccines, mifepristone safe and effective in confirmation hearing
news.summary: The Senate Committee on Health, Education, Labor and Pensions (HELP) today questioned Heidi Overton, M.D., Ph.D., Trump’s pick for FDA commissioner, in a hearing marked by tightrope-walking on issues like vaccines, abortions, flavored vapes and whether or not President Donald Trump is capable of being wrong.

news.title: ‘It’s actually very radical’: NIH debuts tool to help scientists navigate biomedical database
news.summary: The NIH’s National Library of Medicine has released the pilot version of a new tool designed to help scientists plumbing the library’s digital trove of scientific papers find related research faster.

news.title: China’s Henlius carves out $440M T-cell engager deal with Amberstone
news.summary: Fosun Pharma subsidiary Henlius Biotech has signed a $440 million biobucks deal with California-based Amberstone Biosciences to work on T-cell engagers.

news.title: Acadia misses mark in Alzheimer’s but concludes phase 3 ‘absolutely worth’ pursuing
news.summary: Acadia Pharmaceuticals’ phase 2 Alzheimer’s disease trial has missed its primary endpoint, but the company and analysts alike saw enough encouraging signals to support the continuation of a phase 3 program.

news.title: Grail survives adcomm vote as it awaits FDA decision for cancer blood test
news.summary: Despite a major trial setback earlier this year and increasing questions over its efficacy, medtech Grail has beaten the odds and seen a positive recommendation for its multi-cancer blood test Galleri from FDA advisors.
